title: Siege of Mombasa (1696–1698)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Mombasa (1696–1698)", at revision 1370743590, opens: "The siege of Mombasa was an attack on the Portuguese city of Mombasa and Fort Jesus by the army of the Ya'rubid ruler of Oman, Saif I bin Sultan, from 13 March 1696 to 13 December 1698." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q17070460, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1696–1698 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
